description: This Dart source file defines the MiniPlayerController class, which manages the state of a mini-player UI component in a Flutter application. It includes properties and methods to control playback state, position, mute status, and captions, and notifies listeners on state changes.

classes.name: MiniPlayerController
classes.description: A lightweight controller for managing the mini-player's state in a Flutter app. It stores primitive state variables and provides methods to update playback, positioning, and UI visibility, extending ChangeNotifier to support reactive updates.

methods.name: startOrUpdateSession
methods.description: Starts or updates a mini-player session with specified content ID, position, and playback state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops and clears the current mini-player session.

methods.name: setPositionSeconds
methods.description: Sets the playback position in seconds, clamped between 0 and 24 hours.

methods.name: setPlaying
methods.description: Sets the playing state (play or pause).

methods.name: togglePlayPause
methods.description: Toggles between play and pause states.

methods.name: seekBy
methods.description: Adjusts the playback position by a delta in seconds.

methods.name: toggleCaptionsPlaceholder
methods.description: Toggles the captions placeholder state (not real captions).
